text.en: The Brewers get on base and strike hitters out. The Rays rarely strike out or walk anyone, and won 8 more games than their run differential predicts.
text.zh-TW: Brewers 靠上壘和三振；Rays 很少被三振、也很少投保送，還比得失分預期多贏了 8 場。

title.zh-TW: 先發看 Rays，牛棚看 Brewers

text.en: This postseason the Brewers' bullpen has thrown more innings than their starters, with a 1.33 ERA. The Rays lean on starters who go deep.
text.zh-TW: 這次季後賽 Brewers 牛棚投的局數比先發還多，ERA 1.33；Rays 則靠能吃局的先發。

label.zh-TW: Brewers 牛棚 · 季後賽局數 / ERA

text.en: A lockdown bullpen and a steadier lineup. The Rays' path: starters who go deep, and a long series that wears the Brewers' bullpen down.
text.zh-TW: 鐵牛棚加上比較穩的打線。Rays 的劇本：先發吃局，把系列賽拖長、拖累 Brewers 的牛棚。
